metadata.title: मध्य प्रदेश के भीलों को जानते हैं? What do you know about Bhil tribe of MP?
metadata.description: Main Bhi Bharat  team is back from Madhya Pradesh after week long stay in Tribal areas of Madhya Pradesh. We will be putting out a series of new episode of Main Bhi Bharat form these areas. But before that we are organising this quiz for you on the tribes of Madhya Pradesh, if your answer is right, you will get a prize.
